sections.title: Sales team kit
sections.why: Every conversation the team already has can carry the quiz or the offer, at no cost.

items.title: Text to a cold or stalled lead (Home Portrait)
items.meta: New Home Consultants and online sales counselors · 1-to-1 texts
items.body: Hi [first name], it is [your name] with Mitchell Homes. We just launched something I think you will like. Answer eight quick questions about the home you have in mind, and we paint a portrait of it. About 90 seconds: mitchellhomesliving.com/portrait. Happy to walk through it with you after.
items.notes: Use the tracked link when texting from Builder Studio; the plain address is fine from a phone.

items.title: Text to an in-market lead (Design Dollars)
items.meta: New Home Consultants · 1-to-1 texts
items.body: Hi [first name], quick update from Mitchell. Every home now starts with $5,000 in Design Dollars for your Design Center selections, and it goes up to $25,000 the more you personalize. Sign now and it is locked; your tier is set later, when you make your selections. Want me to show you where your plan would land on the ladder?
items.notes: Design Dollars never come off the base price and are never cash. If asked, say so plainly.

items.title: Voicemail
items.meta: New Home Consultants · about 25 seconds
items.body: Hi [first name], this is [your name], a New Home Consultant with Mitchell Homes. I am calling with two things. Every Mitchell home now comes with $5,000 in Design Dollars, and it grows to $25,000 the more you personalize. And if you want to see what your home could look like first, we built a 90-second quiz at mitchellhomesliving.com slash portrait. Call or text me back at [number]. Thanks, [first name].

items.title: Opening the first call with a Home Portrait lead
items.meta: From the Home Portrait sales deck
items.body:
1. Open with their portrait. Say the portrait name and the region. They will recognize it.
2. Ask about one thing they picked: a must-have, the land, or the people who will live there.
3. Offer the next step their portrait named: a Design Studio visit, or a land walk if they have land.
Skip: So, what are you looking for? They already told you.
items.notes: The full scripts per portrait are in the Home Portrait deck inside the Fall Campaign Guide.

items.title: Email signature line
items.meta: Everyone at Mitchell who emails buyers
items.body: See what your home could look like. Take the Home Portrait quiz: mitchellhomesliving.com/portrait
items.notes: Or use the signature banner image in the print section. Host it in the Builder Studio media library and link it with this URL.

sections.title: Sales team follow-ups
sections.why: Marketing starts the conversation; a person finishes it. Each follow-up fires on what the buyer just did, in the consultant's own voice.

items.title: Quiz taker: first text
items.meta: Within 15 minutes of the quiz · online sales counselor · text
items.body: Hi [first name], this is [your name] with Mitchell Homes. Your [portrait name] just came through, and I love the [first must have] you picked. Would you like to see what it would take to build it? I can set up a quick call or a Design Studio visit.
items.notes: Merge fields: contact.portrait_name and contact.design_dollars_focus. Only when the buyer gave text consent on the quiz. This replaces the generic first touch for quiz leads.

items.title: Quiz taker: next-day email
items.meta: Next day, if no reply · online sales counselor or New Home Consultant · personal email
items.body:
Subject: Your [portrait name]

Hi [first name],

I had a chance to look at your Home Portrait. [Region] is a beautiful place to build, and the [first must have] you picked tells me a lot about how you want to live.

Two things worth knowing as you think it over. Mitchell self-funds every build, so on land you own there is zero down and no construction loan. And every Mitchell home now starts with $5,000 in Design Dollars, up to $25,000 the more you personalize.

Would you like to see the Design Studio, or start with a 15-minute call? Reply with a time that works and I will hold it for you.

[your name]
New Home Consultant, Mitchell Homes
[your phone]

Design Dollars apply to Design Center selections only. Not applied to base price. No cash value.
items.notes: Plain text, sent from the consultant's own address so it reads like a person, because it is one.

items.title: Clicked a Design Dollars email: text
items.meta: Within one business day of the click · online sales counselor · text
items.body: Hi [first name], [your name] with Mitchell Homes. Every home now starts with $5,000 in Design Dollars for your Design Center selections, up to $25,000 the more you personalize. Happy to show you where your plan would land. Would a quick call this week work?
items.notes: Never mention that they clicked. The click only decides who hears from us first.

items.title: Design Dollars: personal email to active leads
items.meta: Friday, October 23 · every New Home Consultant to their own active leads · personal email
items.body:
Subject: Where your plan lands on the Design Dollars ladder

Hi [first name],

Quick note on something new this fall. Every Mitchell home now comes with $5,000 in Design Dollars for your Design Center selections, and the more you personalize, the more Mitchell adds, up to $25,000. Choose $60,000 in selections, for example, and Mitchell adds $15,000, so you take home $75,000 worth.

You do not have to pick a single finish to secure it. Sign now and your incentive is locked; your tier is set later, when you sit down at the Design Center.

If you tell me the plan you are leaning toward, I will show you where it would land on the ladder.

[your name]
New Home Consultant, Mitchell Homes
[your phone]

Design Dollars apply to Design Center selections only. Not applied to base price. No cash value.
items.notes: One email per lead, from their own consultant. Skip anyone who already heard about Design Dollars in a call this month.

items.title: Deadline week: personal email
items.meta: Tuesday, October 27 · every New Home Consultant to active leads · personal email
items.body:
Subject: Before October 31

Hi [first name],

If building on your land is on your list for next year, this is a good week to lock it in. Reserve by Saturday, October 31, and your Design Dollars are locked: $5,000 to start, up to $25,000 the more you personalize. Your tier is set later, when you choose your finishes.

The reservation deposit is $150, and that is all Mitchell receives until closing.

Want to talk it through this week? Reply with a time, or call me at the number below.

[your name]
New Home Consultant, Mitchell Homes
[your phone]

Design Dollars apply to Design Center selections only. Not applied to base price. No cash value.
items.notes: If Mitchell approves a November date, the same email runs the week of November 23 with the new date.

items.title: Deadline week: text
items.meta: Thursday, October 29 · every New Home Consultant to active leads with text consent · text
items.body: Hi [first name], a quick heads-up from [your name] at Mitchell. Reserve by Saturday, Oct 31 and your Design Dollars are locked. You choose your finishes later, and the deposit is $150. Want me to walk you through it before Saturday?

items.title: Clicked a Four Buyers email or page: text
items.meta: Within one business day · New Home Consultant for that division · text
items.body: Hi [first name], [your name] with Mitchell Homes. If you own land, it can count toward your home: zero down, zero closing costs and no construction loan, because Mitchell self-funds every build. Would you like me to run the numbers for your land?
items.notes: Financing terms are illustrative only and subject to credit approval; say so if they ask about numbers.

items.title: Landowner: follow-up email
items.meta: Two days after the text, if no reply · New Home Consultant · personal email
items.body:
Subject: Your land, in numbers

Hi [first name],

Most landowners do not realize how far along they already are. With Mitchell, the land you own counts toward the home, there is no construction loan, and there is one closing instead of two.

Tell me the county and roughly how many acres, and I will put together what building on it could look like, including the plans that fit.

Financing terms are illustrative only and subject to credit approval. Not a commitment to lend.

[your name]
New Home Consultant, Mitchell Homes
[your phone]
items.notes: Plain text. Attach nothing; the conversation is the point.

items.title: Looking for land: text
items.meta: Within one business day of a No Land click or a quiz answer of still looking · New Home Consultant · text
items.body: Hi [first name], [your name] with Mitchell Homes. We do not sell land, but you can start designing now and bring us the lot when you find it. Would you like to walk the plan library at a Design Studio?
items.notes: Never recommend counties or describe areas as desirable.

items.title: After a Design Center visit: text
items.meta: Same day · Design Consultant or New Home Consultant · text
items.body: Thank you for coming in today, [first name]. You are [amount] away from the next Design Dollars tier, which adds [amount] more for your selections. Anything you want me to price before we talk next?
items.notes: Scott's rule at the design table: tell them the gap. Fill the amounts from the ladder.

Text: Hi [first name], [your name] with Mitchell Homes. It has been a while. We built a 90-second quiz that paints a portrait of the home you have in mind: mitchellhomesliving.com/portrait. If building is still on your list, I am here.

Answer eight questions about the home you have in mind, and we paint your Home Portrait, along with what it would take to build it on your land. It takes about 90 seconds: mitchellhomesliving.com/portrait. If the timing is right, I would love to help.

[your name]
New Home Consultant, Mitchell Homes
[your phone]

sections.title: Website and automations

items.title: Website announcement bar, Design Dollars
items.meta: mitchellhomesinc.com, top of every page, through October 31
items.body: Every Mitchell home now starts with $5,000 in Design Dollars, up to $25,000. See how it works

items.meta: mitchellhomesinc.com, alternate weeks or after October 31

items.title: Missed-call text-back
items.meta: Builder Studio automation, every division number
items.body: Sorry we missed you. This is Mitchell Homes. A New Home Consultant will call you back shortly. While you wait, see what your home could look like: mitchellhomesliving.com/portrait
items.notes: Only where the account already sends a missed call text and the caller can receive texts. Keep the callback promise as written; it does not name a time.

items.title: Every form thank-you page
items.meta: All Builder Studio and older campaign forms
items.body:
Thank you. A New Home Consultant will be in touch soon. While you wait, take 90 seconds to see what your home could look like.
[Take the Quiz]
items.notes: Adds the quiz to the busiest moment of intent on the site. The answers then reach the consultant before the first call.

sections.title: Events
sections.why: Mitchell already has five studios and an event format; they can carry both campaigns without paid media.

items.title: Bring Your Photos Saturdays
items.meta: Proposal · all five Design Centers · needs Mitchell approval and staffing
items.body: Open studio hours on two Saturdays this fall. Buyers bring the photos they have been saving, sit with a Design Consultant, and see what their favorites cost and which Design Dollars tier they would reach. Promote it in the Design Dollars emails, a text, the Google Business Profile event post for each studio, and Facebook events.
items.notes: Ties the Design Dollars offer to the Grounded Dreamer argument: one appointment, bring the photos.

items.title: Fold both campaigns into the next Sip and See
items.meta: Proposal · existing event · needs Mitchell approval
items.body: At the next Sip and See, put the Home Portrait counter card on every table and the Design Dollars card at the design table. Guests take the quiz on their phones and walk out with their portrait in their inbox.
items.notes: Uses an event Mitchell already runs; adds no cost beyond printing.

items.title: Behind the Build live: your Design Dollars questions
items.meta: Proposal · Facebook and YouTube live · needs Scott and Deven
items.body: A 20-minute live session where Scott and Deven answer Design Dollars and SimplyMitchell questions from viewers. Collect questions beforehand with a social post and a line in the Design Dollars email.
items.notes: The recording becomes three or four Shorts, one question each.

sections.title: Print
sections.why: Landowners in rural counties still read the board at the feed store; the QR code makes every flyer measurable.

items.meta: Design Center counters, event tables, closing packets
items.body: Every home is a portrait. Discover Yours. QR code to the quiz.
items.notes: Files: portrait-counter-card.pdf and .png. Print on heavy card stock; fold a second copy into a tent if needed.

items.title: Design Dollars counter card (5 x 7 in)

items.notes: Files: design-dollars-counter-card.pdf and .png. Lets a consultant point at the gap to the next tier, as Scott asked.

items.title: Landowner community board flyer (8.5 x 11 in)
items.meta: Feed and farm supply stores, hardware stores, county extension offices, libraries, in the counties Mitchell serves

items.notes: Files: landowner-community-flyer.pdf and .png. Ask before posting; many stores keep a community board for exactly this. Replace monthly.
